# Assignment File Guidelines

This file describes the expected structure and standards for all assignment README files in this project.

## Structure

Each assignment README should follow the template structure below:

- `# 📘 Assignment: [Assignment Title]`
- `## 🎯 Objective`
  - Briefly describe what the student will build or learn.
- `## 📝 Tasks`
  - Provide one or more task sections.
  - Each task should include:
    - `### 🛠️ [Task Title]`
    - `#### Description`
    - `#### Requirements`
- `## 🚀 How to run`
  - Include clear instructions for running the assignment locally.
- `## 📂 Files`
  - List the assignment files the student should use or modify.
- `## ✅ Submission`
  - Provide guidance on what to submit and any formatting or testing expectations.
- `## ✨ Extensions (optional)`
  - Offer optional challenge ideas.
- `## 🎓 Learning Outcomes`
  - Highlight the skills students should practice.

## Writing Guidelines

- Use positive, student-friendly language.
- Keep instructions clear and concise.
- Prefer active voice and direct commands.
- Avoid requiring external dependencies unless explicitly stated.
- Keep file and function names consistent with the assignment folder.

## Standards

- All assignments should be easy to scan.
- Use bold or code formatting for filenames and commands.
- Keep requirements actionable and measurable.
- Make sure the student can start with the provided starter code.
- Refer to the template in `templates/assignment-template.md` for layout.
